verdict.rationale: Missive publishes a complete REST endpoint reference covering conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels and more. Each endpoint has an example request against public.missiveapp.com/v1, and the pages are AI-readable as raw Markdown with an llms.txt index. The docs explicitly state there is no live try-it runner and no OpenAPI spec, and probes found no openapi/swagger file, so the reference is static rather than interactive. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser try-it console, an OpenAPI spec to drive interactive tooling, and hands-on corroboration that the examples run as documented.
